investment_strategy: Build a moderately aggressive, AI-centric equity portfolio focused on dominant platforms and critical infrastructure with strong fundamentals and supportive analyst sentiment, while consciously limiting exposure to the most volatile/high-risk names. Given a relatively elevated but not extreme VIX (~20), high but stable 10Y yields (~4.2%), and flat-to-soft recent index performance, the strategy emphasizes quality (profitability, ROE, balance-sheet strength and consistent earnings beats) and diversification across AI value-chain segments (cloud & platforms, chips & foundry, networking & security, enterprise AI, and consumer AI). Position sizing is used as the primary risk lever: large core weights go to mega-cap leaders with moderate volatility and strong growth, while high-volatility or structurally riskier names receive smaller satellite allocations.
